verdict.rationale: Runway's pricing page lists music, voice and sound effects generation, and the product describes generating video, images and audio in one workspace, so creators can produce sound effects and music in the same tool. Nothing shows the audio being generated to match a specific scene or video, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: evidence of scene-matched or video-to-audio generation, ambient audio specifically, documentation of the audio workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool

citations.quote: An all-in-one cloud-based creative platform that offers endless ways to generate and edit video, images and audio in one workspace.
